dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the wide mid-body section toward the posterior peduncle visible in the lower third of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical protrusion on the left lateral margin relative to the more uniform, slightly recessed right lateral margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with a uniform low-contrast grey tonal shift across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct elongated, high-contrast white linear mark positioned along the central longitudinal axis of the lower dorsal region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle longitudinal shadowing along the central axis indicating the topological elevation of the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Elongated, vertical linear scar/mark on the mid-to-lower dorsal midline.
